Soul Embassy

A diary across worlds. A search for home, written by the one who is searching.

He does not remember where he comes from, so he travels. He stays amongst the people, learns their ways, and writes down the truth of every place, even the parts others miss. He climbs for the very top, where the knowledge and the secrets are kept, because he believes the secrets at the top will one day tell him who he is. A searcher of truth. A player who sees the whole board. This diary is his record, and it is still being written.

The Seeker’s Eye

Some see only stars. He sees the pattern.

Look at the two gold dots at the top. Let your eyes relax, as if you were looking through the picture at something far behind it, until the two dots become three. Then let your gaze drift slowly down, and the door will rise out of the stars.

A door only opens for patient eyes.
